constraints.constraint: Keep penguins as the camera's main subject.
constraints.A_evidence: Several adult penguins dominate the foreground.
constraints.B_evidence: A group of adult penguins fills the frame.

constraints.constraint: Show the penguins from a different camera angle than the reference.
constraints.A_evidence: A close, low viewpoint looks up toward the penguins with sky visible behind their heads, unlike the reference's wider colony view.
constraints.B_evidence: The penguins are viewed more frontally along the shoreline, with water behind them instead of the reference's view across a dense chick colony.

constraints.constraint: Include a cloudy background behind the penguins.
constraints.A_evidence: Large gray clouds visibly fill the sky behind the penguins.
constraints.B_evidence: The background consists of shoreline and blue water; no cloudy sky is visible.

judgment.reason: A shows the penguins from a different viewpoint with a clearly cloudy sky behind them. B changes the viewpoint but lacks the required cloudy background.
